summary: Current raw OPFS composite AbortSignal remains packaged head; linked rev0198 is a deep-read mission/waste correction map. It names the heart as boring browser-local mutation, calls out proof-product inversion and source/artifact budget pressure, adds OPFS privacy/IO posture from current research, and sets the next change order toward a tiny runtime-core package plus out-of-tree evidence cube.
nonClaims: No OPFS quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, privacy guarantee, Service Worker lifetime, browser-kill recovery, Web Lock fairness, or cross-browser proof.
Mission/waste correction map is analysis and next-change ordering only.
